entries.condition: printed in the served report's Appendix B as the lead of the tool effects block, after the isolation block inside the disclosure block, when the disclosure record holds an effects part and effects_lines gives a line; a record stored without the part prints none

the lead of the line naming the tools declared to run the sample's code natively, and of the line for under emulation, whose record does not hold the run: a declared when, or a row stored before calls were counted by how they ended (no completed field), with a call taken as completed
basis: effects row executes, completed, when, calls

entries.condition: the lead of the line naming the tools, other than those declared to do none of the three, with a call not run, refused or failed, one line for each of the three in that order

the lead of the line naming the tools declared to run the sample's code natively, and of the line for under emulation, each with a counted completed call (the row's completed) and no declared when: a completed call of a tool whose declared work is running the code is that run

the lead of the lines naming the tools with a completed call declared to reach only the sandbox service their server fronts, the configured case-memory store, or the network only to fetch or refresh reference data they keep, each said as declared (a named mode is only ever a declaration's); each tool with its declared when

the lead of the lines naming the tools with a completed call that reach the network (network true), one line per origin as network_from records it, or as a row stored before it holds it (network_from): declared; taken, as a tool declared to send the hash out, declared to send the bytes to a third party, or taken to send the file out (built rows the cautious answer forced, the bytes by third_party_from); taken (a stored row whose network sits beside a sent hash or file, or that records no origin); stated by its server's own declaration its block does not trust; said by its server's own hint
basis: effects row network, network_from, network_by, third_party, third_party_from, completed

entries.condition: named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose declaration leaves executes unset
named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose network is answered by no declaration, statement or hint
named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose declaration leaves third_party unset
beside a tool in a line on reaching the network whose server's own openWorldHint is false: that the hint says it does not reach outside its server; nothing otherwise

names where each tool was called through in every line of the block: a server that recorded no source, the platform's own tools, an in-process source by its declared label (or as the in-process source), a tool server, a provider's tool server, any other source

beside a tool in the not-run, refused or failed line when that count is not every call of the tool: the count of all its calls, with the steps never run and, for a refusal, the answers served, counted by the row's shape
basis: effects row calls, served, not_run, refused, failed

entries.condition: beside a tool in a line on reaching the network or on sending the hash whose declaration says it answers offline when given no credentials: that declaration, as declared; nothing otherwise

beside a tool in the ran-the-sample's-code lines: where the isolation part placed its source's read (no read recorded, the worker process, a started process kept by measurement, kept by a declared launcher or not shown kept, a local server, outside this machine, or untold)

beside a tool in the lines on the sandbox service its server fronts: at a host the disclosure places on this machine (the operator's own), at a host outside it, or that where it went cannot be told, with the disclosure's reason or that the record does not say

the tool effects block of the served report's Appendix B for a disclosure record with an effects part: the line that the part may be incomplete where a partial reason is recorded; that no tool call was recorded; or, for tools with a completed call, the lines on running the sample's code (ran where a counted call completed under no declared when, else declared to run), the sandboxes declared, the network by where each answer came from (_REACHES) and in a named mode (_REACHED), the hash declared sent, the bytes declared sent or handed to the sandbox a server fronts where the declaration states them (third_party_from declared), else the file taken as handed or sent out of the deployment, each tool with its declared when and offline condition, then the tools declared to do none, server hints and statements, the calls that did not complete, and the questions a declaration leaves open; [] for a record without the part
basis: disclosure.effects partial_reason, tools (each row's counts, declared answers, network_from, third_party_from, when, offline_without_credentials, hints)
